goal: Make the scheduled Author Lane Abandonment Audit report author-capacity truth independently of historical preview-readiness failures, while preserving the existing preview-readiness checks in their own lane and fail-closing on unreadable capacity. This repairs issue #3541 live exit 3 without releasing any claim or weakening preview promotion.
prohibited_actions: Do not change migrations, database objects, or application rows.
Do not change preview admission or production promotion checks.
Do not treat an unreadable capacity claim as a clean audit.
assumptions: The abandonment audit is an author-capacity audit; preview readiness belongs to a separate domain and remains visible in full reconciliation.
The current scheduled audit reaches full reconciliation but exits 3 on unrelated preview errors while all 20 capacity facts are readable.
stop_conditions: Stop if the capacity domain is unreadable.
Stop if review finds this weakens preview preparation, merge or production controls.
Stop if a required path falls outside allowed_paths.
